reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Happen you know that [in eac]h one of these five garments that the [First] Man summoned there are five powers. They shall be counted to the [likeness of each] other, these five, and five times [five completes] their number. However, at the time [of the descent to the deep,] the summons went down. The answer wished to ascend with it. And the summons with the obedience [constitute] twenty-five characteristics in their twenty-five limbs, [which] are the sons of the Man. The summons and [the obed]ience were raised to the heights through them.

Just as their fa[ther] the living Man raised himself up through them, by these these other ones have set up all things a[bov]e and below. Indeed, these are what are called pentecost, the fifty great days that are the [archetypes of the] holy [d]ays. They fasted from their [foo]d, [w]hich is their own.

So, from that time until [the time] of [the adv]ent of Jesus the Splendour, the glorious one who came [and gave to them t]heir food which is the [nourishment] of sou[l], which is the summons and the obedience [joined as one in] that spiritual food. They rele[ased it throughout] all these fifty days, which [is to say,] this living food suffices for all of them. It filled them all with power and richness and life. Light [is] this living food that [they received and] became rich.
